metadata.title: Immunofluorescence (IF) staining of cultured cells
metadata.purpose: Localize a target antigen in adherent cultured cells by fixing and permeabilizing the cells, labeling with a primary antibody and a fluorophore-conjugated secondary antibody, counterstaining nuclei with DAPI, and imaging by fluorescence microscopy.
metadata.scope: Indirect immunofluorescence of adherent mammalian cells grown on glass coverslips, using paraformaldehyde fixation, Triton X-100 permeabilization for intracellular targets, and a rabbit primary detected by a goat-anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 secondary. Not covering methanol fixation, tissue sections, or live-cell surface-only staining.
metadata.estimatedTime: ~4-6 h (or overnight if primary antibody incubated at 4 C)
beforeYouBegin: Grow cells on glass coverslips (or chambered slides) to the desired confluency before starting.
Choose a primary antibody validated for ICC/IF; match the secondary antibody host and specificity to the primary (this protocol pairs a rabbit primary with a goat-anti-rabbit secondary).
Keep samples protected from light from the secondary-antibody step onward to preserve fluorophore signal.

materials.name: Paraformaldehyde (4% in PBS)
materials.hazard: Toxic; suspected carcinogen; use in a fume hood.

materials.name: PBS
materials.specification: Phosphate-buffered saline, pH 7.4; wash and diluent.
materials.rawText: Rinse cells twice with PBS, then wash 3 x 5 min. with PBS

materials.name: Triton X-100 (0.1% in PBS)
materials.specification: Non-ionic detergent for permeabilization of intracellular targets.
materials.rawText: Permeabilize samples with 0.1-0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS (5 min)

materials.name: Blocking buffer
materials.specification: Normal serum from the secondary-antibody host species (e.g. 5% normal goat serum) or 2% BSA in PBS; may include 0.1% Triton X-100. Exact blocker is user-selected.
materials.rawText: blocking buffer (e.g. 5% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100, 1x PBS) (30 min, room temperature)

materials.name: Primary antibody (rabbit, target-specific)
materials.specification: Rabbit anti-target primary antibody validated for ICC/IF. Target and exact dilution are assay-specific.
materials.rawText: Incubate with primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer for 1-2 hours at room temperature or overnight at 4C

materials.name: Secondary antibody - Goat anti-Rabbit IgG (H+L), Alexa Fluor 488
materials.specification: Cross-adsorbed goat anti-rabbit IgG (H+L), Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate.
materials.rawText: fluorochrome-conjugated secondary antibodies at appropriate dilution (typically 1:500 - 1:1000) ... (1 h, room temperature in the dark)

materials.name: Anti-fade mounting medium
materials.specification: Mounting medium with anti-fade agent (DAPI-containing versions available).
materials.rawText: Place a drop of mounting medium containing anti-fade onto a slide

equipment.name: Fluorescence (or confocal) microscope
equipment.settings: Filter sets/laser lines for DAPI (~358/461 nm) and Alexa Fluor 488 (~495/519 nm)

equipment.name: Humidified staining chamber
equipment.settings: Room temperature or 4 C; prevents coverslips from drying during incubations

samples.name: Adherent cultured cells on coverslip
samples.organism: Mammalian cell line (specific line not fixed by this protocol)
samples.description: Cells grown on a glass coverslip to be fixed and stained.

samples.name: Fixed and permeabilized cells
samples.description: Cells after PFA fixation and Triton X-100 permeabilization, ready for antibody labeling.

samples.name: Stained, mounted coverslip
samples.description: Immunolabeled cells mounted on a slide, ready for fluorescence imaging.

steps.safetyNotes: Use PFA in a fume hood.

steps.action: Permeabilize cells with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS.
steps.expectedResult: Membranes permeabilized for intracellular antibody access.
steps.criticalNotes: Omit or reduce Triton for membrane/surface antigens.
Use serum from the same host species as the secondary antibody (goat serum for a goat secondary).

steps.action: Incubate with primary antibody diluted in blocking buffer.
steps.criticalNotes: Alternatively incubate overnight at 4 C. Dilution is antibody-specific.

steps.action: Incubate with fluorophore-conjugated secondary antibody in the dark.

parameters.rawText: 1 h, room temperature in the dark

steps.expectedResult: Secondary antibody bound; target now fluorescent.
steps.criticalNotes: Protect from light from this step onward.

steps.action: Mount the coverslip onto a slide with anti-fade mounting medium (cells facing the medium).
steps.expectedResult: Sample mounted and ready to image.
steps.criticalNotes: Avoid trapping bubbles; a DAPI-containing mountant can replace the separate DAPI step.

steps.action: Image on a fluorescence or confocal microscope using DAPI and Alexa Fluor 488 channels.
steps.expectedResult: Target-specific fluorescence localized in cells; nuclei labeled by DAPI.

controls.name: No-primary (secondary-only) control
controls.description: Omit the primary antibody to reveal non-specific secondary-antibody binding / autofluorescence.

controls.name: Isotype control
controls.description: Primary replaced by matched isotype at the same concentration to assess non-specific primary binding.

controls.name: DAPI-only / unstained control
controls.description: Establishes background and channel bleed-through references.

expectedOutputs: Fluorescence micrographs showing target-specific Alexa Fluor 488 signal with expected subcellular localization.
DAPI-labeled nuclei for cell counting and co-localization reference.

troubleshooting.cause: Insufficient blocking; secondary too concentrated; inadequate washing
troubleshooting.solution: Extend/optimize blocking; titrate secondary; add washes; include no-primary control

troubleshooting.cause: Epitope masked by fixation; primary too dilute; incompatible antibody
troubleshooting.solution: Try methanol fixation or antigen retrieval; increase primary; verify ICC/IF validation
Use anti-fade mountant; minimize light exposure; reduce excitation intensity

safety: Paraformaldehyde is toxic and a suspected carcinogen - handle in a fume hood with gloves.
DAPI is a potential mutagen - handle with gloves and dispose per institutional rules.
Cultured cells may be biohazardous - handle at the appropriate biosafety level.
limitations: Values are grounded in two general-purpose vendor IF protocols (Biotium, src1; Abcam ICC, src2); the specific primary antibody, its dilution, the exact blocking agent, cell line, and microscope filter configuration are experiment-specific and marked needsReview. Triton X-100 permeabilization is appropriate for intracellular targets and should be omitted for surface/membrane epitopes.
